title: smime-tree: add test for self-anchored leaf cert; fix AllTrustAnchorsExpired deprecation message; move TODO comment to beads; document mixed RSA+P-384 CEK wrapping behavior
description: Four items: (1) add test where signer_cert is itself in trust_anchors; (2) fix AllTrustAnchorsExpired deprecation message — TooDeep is unrelated, should say CertificateExpired only; (3) move 'If multi-signer support is added later' TODO comment in sign.rs:120 to a beads issue and remove from source; (4) document that mixed RSA+P-384 recipient lists wrap a 256-bit CEK with RSA PKCS#1v15.
